paper_title: First Search for Axion-Like Particles in a Storage Ring Using a Polarized Deuteron Beam
coupling_convention: d_n in e*cm (oscillating deuteron EDM amplitude d_AC)
notes: First storage-ring ALP search using polarized deuteron beam at COSY. Primary result: 90% CL upper limit on oscillating deuteron EDM |d_AC| < 6.4e-23 e*cm, over axion mass range 0.495-0.502 neV/c2 (frequency 120.0-121.4 kHz). Encoded as a near-flat line across the scanned mass range using the average limit value; the actual curve fluctuates slightly with frequency. Paper also derives limits on g_adgamma, C_d^G/f_a, and C_d/f_a (axion-wind), but the fundamental measured quantity is the oscillating EDM (AxionEDM).
